{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2016–17 |team= California Golden Bears |image=California Golden Bears logo.svg |image_size=140px |conference=Pac-12 Conference |conference_link=Pac-12 Conference men's basketball |division= |short_conf= Pac–12 |CoachRank= |APRank= |record= 21–13 |conf_record= 10–8 |head_coach=[[Cuonzo Martin]] |hc_year= 3rd |asst_coach1= [[Tracy Webster]] |asst_coach2= [[Wyking Jones]] |asst_coach3= [[Tim O'Toole (basketball)|Tim O'Tool]] |stadium= [[Haas Pavilion]] |champion= |bowl= [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |bowl_result= First round }} {{2016–17 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 California Golden Bears men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was [[Cuonzo Martin]]'s third year as head coach at California. The Golden Bears played their home games at [[Haas Pavilion]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 21–13, 10–8 in Pac-12 play to finish in a tie for fifth place. They defeated [[2016–17 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|Oregon State]] and [[2016–17 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]] in [[2017 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to advance to the semifinals, where they lost to [[2016–17 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]]. They were one of the last four teams not selected for the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and thus received a No. 1 seed in the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they lost in the first round to [[2016–17 Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners men's basketball team|Cal State Bakersfield]]. On March 15, head coach Cuonzo Martin resigned to become the head coach at [[Missouri Tigers men's basketball|Missouri]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college-basketball/2017/03/15/cuonzo-martin-resigns-california-missouri-job|title = Cuonzo Martin resigns from Cal, reportedly off to Missouri}} He finished at Cal with a three-year record of 62–39. On March 24, Cal promoted assistant coach [[Wyking Jones]] to head coach.{{cite news|url=http://www.dailycal.org/2017/03/24/wyking-jones-promoted-cal-mens-basketball-head-coach/|title=Wyking Jones promoted to Cal men's basketball head coach|first=Chris|last=Tril|newspaper=[[The Daily Californian]]|location=[[Berkeley, California|Berkeley]]|date=March 24, 2017|accessdate=July 18, 2017}} ==Previous season== The [[2015-16 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|Golden Bears]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] with a record of 23–11, 12–6 in [[2015-16 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in a tie for third place. They defeated [[2015-16 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|Oregon State]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to advance to the semifinals, where they lost to [[2015-16 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they lost in the first round to [[2015-16 Hawaii Rainbow Warriors basketball team|Hawaii]]. ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
